interpretation: One FLAC and one WAV trickle admission round passed strict existing harness assertions. Both original FLAC peers reached frame deadlines; original WAV peers disconnected on generation overrun, so this is not proof of their deadline path or decoded playback. UART capture fault counters were flat and both ports returned to LISTEN-only. Largest PSRAM block eventually returned to its baseline 917504 bytes; no arbitrary internal reserve or long-endurance acceptance inferred. Quiet input and Shazam off.
